verdict.rationale: Zep does generate AI-derived artifacts from ingested data — thread summaries (natural-language summaries incrementally updated by Zep) and entity/relation extraction into the Context Graph — which qualify as AI-generated insights from user data. However, there is no evidence of proactive 'suggestions' or recommendation-style outputs, nor any user-facing dashboard/UI surfacing these insights to an end user; the artifacts are primarily consumed programmatically by the calling agent/app rather than presented as insights inside a product experience. Missing for 10: evidence of suggestion/recommendation generation, and evidence of a UI or interface that surfaces these AI-generated insights directly to a human/ai-native user.
